Maria Lopez.description: Maria Lopez has finished the consultation and is wrapping up the visit
chat: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly what happens during these episodes of unresponsiveness, such as how long they last and if there is any loss of muscle tone or jerking movements? Also, does the patient regain awareness immediately afterward, or is there a period of confusion?

The episodes usually last about three or four minutes, where I just stare and my face makes strange faces, but I don't remember anything happening. My brother says I make hand gestures and wake up looking confused and very tired afterward. There is no shaking or falling down, just this weird muddy taste in my mouth right before it starts.
